_method: control flow transcribed branch by branch; response envelope is BasePaginator.paginate (utils/paginator.py:654+): 12-key envelope incl. grouped_by/sub_grouped_by/extra_stats; byte-identity pinned by PIDASHCONV-90 list tests

branches.note: filters come from the shared issue_filters helper (issues domain); they are spread as issue__-prefixed kwargs

order_by passes the raw query param straight into ORDER BY — an unknown field raises FieldError which handle_exception maps to 500 {'error': 'Something went wrong please try again later'} (BUG: port as-is)
default ['-2'] when the param is absent; explicit ?status= with only null tokens yields [] which is falsy so NO status filter is applied (all statuses listed)
branches.parse: request.GET.get('status', '-2').split(',') minus any 'null' token; filter(status__in=...) only if the remainder is non-empty

orm: IntakeIssue.objects.filter(intake_id, project_id, **issue_filters).select_related('issue').prefetch_related('issue__labels').annotate(label_ids=COALESCE(ArrayAgg(issue__labels__id, distinct, filter=not-null AND label_issue not deleted), [])).order_by(order_by).filter(status__in=intake_status)?
sql: SELECT "intake_issues".*, COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT "labels"."id") FILTER (WHERE ("labels"."id" IS NOT NULL AND "label_issue"."deleted_at" IS NULL)), '{}') AS "label_ids" FROM "intake_issues" LEFT OUTER JOIN "issues" ON ("intake_issues"."issue_id" = "issues"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "label_issue" ON ("issues"."id" = "label_issue"."issue_id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "labels" ON ("label_issue"."label_id" = "labels"."id") WHERE ("intake_issues"."intake_id" = %s AND "intake_issues"."project_id" = %s AND <issue_filters> AND "intake_issues"."status" IN (...) AND "intake_issues"."deleted_at" IS NULL) GROUP BY "intake_issues"."id", "issues"."id" ORDER BY <order_by> LIMIT <per_page> OFFSET <cursor>
